items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: I saw Phil Woods and Rob McConnell handle it in their way

ctx.x: What is an annoyance to you in the music business? That’s a broad question but I’m thinking in trio settings? You seem like a fairly calm person to me. What gets under your skin?

Well it used to get under my skin, talkers in the audience and I saw Phil Woods and Rob McConnell handle it in their way and I was surprised they didn’t get shot. And then I’ve handled it in my way. Once I was playing at a club in LaJolla and this couple was sitting right next to the piano talking about redecorating their house. “Well honey I think we should go with pink in the bedroom, and maybe the bathroom should be blue. So after two minutes of it I turned off and I said, “I think you should go with purple in…

Yeah. It’s nice that you have that liberty now to make those kind of choices. Sliding back to composing and arranging, I caught this quote, probably from your website, that you said, “Deadlines are great inspiration.”
